title: WealthAbility Alternatives
keyLine: A CPA class teaches the map. It does not sign your return.
description: Tax-Free Wealth and WealthAbility alternatives: a $197 a month class, a CPA, Anderson Platinum, or our plan. Formula checkout was not on the page we opened.
answer: WealthAbility is Tom Wheelwright's tax education company. He also wrote Tax-Free Wealth, the book many Rich Dad readers buy next. WealthAbility Live listed $197 a month on September 15, 2026. The Tax-Free Formula sales page we opened that day did not print a checkout price. If you want a class, that can be enough. If you want a signed return, hire a CPA. If you want documents and attorneys on tap, that is a membership like Anderson Platinum, not a video. We sell Legacy Wealth Blueprint. It is a written plan plus coaching. We do not file your return.
criteriaIntro: We grouped options by job: class, licensed filer, attorney membership, or a written wealth plan. We skipped lookalikes whose only door was a webinar with no public price.
criteria: The option teaches tax, files tax, or sells legal support we could describe from a live page.
Price is copied from a public page, or we say it was not printed.
We do not reuse Wheelwright's marketing averages as our facts.
We include our own program and say so.

blocks.heading: What WealthAbility sells
paragraphs: [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) is a monthly subscription. The page we opened listed $197 a month, two live sessions a month, a forum, and archives. It is hosted by Tom Wheelwright, CPA. Treat the lesson list as seller copy. We did not sit in the sessions.

The [Tax-Free Formula](https://www.wealthability.com/new-tax-free-formula/) page describes a digital course with modules on deductions, conversion, brackets, credits, and deferral. On September 15, 2026 that page did not print a checkout price in the text we could copy. If you saw $497 on an older screenshot, confirm the live offer. We will not invent it.

Tax-Free Wealth is the book. A book is not a filing position. Mentorship and done-for-you pages we opened did not publish a price. If someone quotes a five-figure WealthAbility coaching fee, ask for the live invoice.

blocks.heading: Pick the next tool by the next job
blocks.intro: These are not 'better WealthAbility.' They do different work.

items.name: Stay with WealthAbility Live
items.summary: Use it if you already own a business or property and you want CPA-led class time at a printed monthly price. Skip it if you only have wages and no rental. A class cannot invent a deduction you do not have. See [tax strategies for W-2 employees](/tax-strategies/for/w2-employees).
items.meta: Job: tax school with a published $197 a month sticker

items.name: A CPA or enrolled agent
items.summary: A certified public accountant or an enrolled agent (EA) can prepare and sign Form 1040. An EA is a tax pro licensed by the IRS to represent taxpayers. A course cannot. See [tax course vs hiring a CPA](/compare/tax-course-vs-cpa).

items.name: Anderson Platinum
items.summary: Attorney and document membership, not a video class. Public price on September 15, 2026: $3,495 to enroll plus $75 a month. Their FAQ said tax filing packages are not included. Full split: [Anderson Platinum vs a tax course](/compare/anderson-platinum-vs-tax-course).
items.meta: Job: legal and entity questions on tap

blocks.label: W-2 limit in one line
paragraphs: After the 401(k) and HSA, most large tax ideas need a business or a rental. A $197 class that talks about entities will not lower a pure wage bill by itself. Fill the IRS buckets first. 2026 employee 401(k) deferral is $24,500 ([IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500)).

blocks.heading: If you only read Tax-Free Wealth
paragraphs: The book is a companion to Rich Dad, not a substitute for a preparer. Next mechanical steps: [Rich Dad alternatives](/compare/rich-dad-alternatives) if you still need a how-to, or a CPA meeting with last year's return in hand.

If a sales page promises you will cut tax by a round percent with no look at your file, walk. The [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) flags easy-profit pitches. We do not call WealthAbility a scam. We also do not repeat their student stories as our proof.

faqs.q: Is WealthAbility the same as Tax-Free Wealth?
faqs.a: Tax-Free Wealth is the book. WealthAbility is the company that sells classes and related offers around that teaching. A book is not a CPA engagement.

faqs.q: How much is the Tax-Free Formula course?
faqs.a: The sales page we opened on September 15, 2026 did not print a price we could copy. Confirm at checkout. Do not trust an old screenshot.

faqs.q: Can a $197 a month class replace Anderson Platinum?
faqs.a: No. One is education. The other is an attorney membership. Different job, different bill.
